description: Trechos de Drenagem da Base Hidrográfica Ottocodificada Multiescalas 2017 da região de Gravataí_ RS is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A Base Hidrográfica Ottocodificada (BHO) utilizada pela ANA na gestão de recursos hídricos é obtida a partir do Mapeamento Sistemático Brasileiro. A BHO é gerada a partir da cartografia digital da hidrografia do país e organizada de modo a gerar informações hidrologicamente consistentes. Coverage: município de Gravataí e área circunvizinha. Its tags are CPACT, drenagem, hidrografia, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
